notes: Task 017 batch-1 board (oracle's own design, thesis-ecosystem sampling board, pulled live via bridge 2026-09-27). Eval view: schematic -- the views disagree on this board more than any other, and every schematic-view finding was verified against raw .epru records before ruling: R3/R6 Value='330' (pcb view read 1k from stale copies), U1/U7/U8 each carried by 3 component entities, C71/C72 Value empty (so the pcb-view MPN WARNs on them do not exist here). A1: 3 duplicate-designator ERRORs ruled defect (the three filter channels were copy-pasted without re-annotation). A2: 2 MPN WARNs ruled defect -- the physical part is the 1k the MPN says; the schematic's value text was hand-edited to 330 without changing the part (实际只有330欧，但是他放的是一个1000欧的电阻，他把值改成了330). A3: 4 rc-cutoff INFO numbers ruled observation (oracle: RC应该没啥问题).

Three placed parts on one page all answer to U1 (an OPA2333 dual op-amp per the model) -- the three filter channels were copy-pasted without re-annotating designators, so the BOM and netlist cannot tell the nine op-amps apart. Verified real in the raw SCH records (3 entities per designator) before ruling.
Ruling A1 (same batch as U1): defect. Second of the three duplicated designators, same cause, same consequence.
Ruling A1 (same batch as U1): defect. Third of the three duplicated designators, same cause, same consequence.

Ruling A2 (oracle xianyuyijinban, 2026-09-27; one decision covering R3/R6): defect. The placed part really is the 1 kohm the MPN (MF1/4W-1K±1%-ST52) declares; the schematic's value text was hand-edited to 330 without swapping the part (oracle: 他把值改成了330). The decode is right, the value text is wrong -- schematic/BOM contradiction introduced by a manual value edit.
Ruling A2 (same batch as R6): defect. Twin position, same MPN, same hand-edited 330 value text, same ruling.

Ruling A4 (oracle xianyuyijinban, 2026-09-27; one decision covering the 17 MPN WARNs of this board, taken after the 048 decoder gap was closed): defect. R2's MPN 0805W8J0103T5E decodes to 10 kohm -- 厚声's 5% (E-24) ordering field with a numeric exponent, 010 x 10^3, readable only since task 048 -- while the schematic declares 33kohm. Order per the BOM and the board gets 10 kohm parts where 33 kohm was designed: the MPN column was filled in wrong. Oracle: 是真缺陷，注 defect 落地。
Ruling A4 (same batch as R2): defect. Twin position, same MPN 0805W8J0103T5E (10 kohm) against board value 33kohm, same root cause, same ruling.

Ruling A4 (same batch; one note covering R30-R44): defect. Order per the BOM and fifteen positions get 10 kohm parts: the MPN column was filled in wrong, the same root cause as R2/R5.
